scope: Synthetic three-point NoCurve MagicPen GLV1, 0.4 pen size and opaque #336699, sixteen quarter-pixel position phases on a 32x32 page at 1x, 2x, and 4x. Native Drawing replay renders transparent host Mesa RGBA8; native premultiplied output is composited over each export blank. The public document SVG is rasterized with resvg, direct document PDF with MuPDF. These controls do not establish Samsung device or saved-note parity.

recipe.native: Run /usr/bin/python3 tmp/vector-parity-plan/magicpen-phase-followup/run.py from the project root. The runner uses inputs.json and capture.py in that directory, the pinned helper snapshot at tmp/conformance-cleanup/native-capture-a241793/conformance, and scratch/apk-analysis-runtime plus scratch/apk-analysis-native; raw native captures are written to /tmp/magic-phase-results. The adapter pins helper, library, and native tool hashes and checks GL state.
recipe.public: Create an isolated checkout at source_revision. Copy inputs.json to /tmp/sdocx-magic-phase/inputs.json. Replace the body of render::tests::dump_magicpen_public_candidate_and_generic_fallback with the retained export-test.rs snippet. Run CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/sdocx-agent-target CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 cargo test -p sdocx --features pdf dump_magicpen_public_candidate_and_generic_fallback --lib in that checkout. It writes actual document SVG and direct document PDF pairs with blank controls to /tmp/magic-phase-export.
recipe.comparison: Run .venv/bin/python tmp/vector-parity-plan/magicpen-phase-followup/public-compare.py. It reads the native captures and public exports above, flips GL readback rows, composites premultiplied native RGBA over each engine blank, and sums absolute RGB error and changed-pixel support. SVG uses resvg 0.45.1; PDF uses MuPDF via PyMuPDF 1.28.2 at 4/3 PDF scale per source unit.
recipe.limitations: Synthetic phase grid and one size/color only; host Mesa and these renderer versions are not Samsung device or saved-note evidence. Renderer rounding and full-frame color comparison affect the reported support and error. Raw render outputs are reproducible intermediates and are not retained; the compact capture and comparison scripts are project-local scratch, not conformance runners.
